name.en: Destroying cover to reshape a fight

summary.zh: 拆掉挡路或挡枪的东西，让原本安全的位置变危险。
summary.en: Remove protection or obstructions to change which positions are safe.

rules.zh: 墙和掩体不是永久边界，特定攻击能把它们破坏。玩家可以先花稀缺资源开洞或清除保护，再让其他单位利用新的视线和路线；同一次破坏也可能暴露自己的队员，因此要按改变后的地图继续行动。
rules.en: Walls and cover are not permanent boundaries: certain attacks destroy them. Spend a limited resource to open a route or remove protection, then exploit new sightlines. The same destruction may expose allies, requiring plans for the changed map.

decisions.zh: 现在用掉爆炸物消除掩体，还是留给后面的敌人？
decisions.en: Spend an explosive to remove cover now or save it for later?

decisions.zh: 开出射线是否也会让自己的后排被敌人看见？
decisions.en: Will the new sightline expose your rear units as well?

effect.zh: 只破坏指定格子容易预测；复杂建筑坍塌会扩大制作和理解成本。
effect.en: Specific destructible tiles are predictable; complex collapse raises production and comprehension costs.

effect.zh: 次数越少，开哪一个口越重要；无限破坏可能让掩体失去价值。
effect.en: Limited uses make the chosen opening matter; unlimited destruction can invalidate cover.

implementation.zh: 破片手榴弹可以破坏掩体和墙体，队友随后可攻击暴露的敌人；较坚固的地形不一定能被一发摧毁。
implementation.en: Frag grenades can destroy cover and walls so teammates can attack exposed targets; tougher terrain may survive one grenade.

observation.zh: 射击界面显示命中率和伤害预估；它用于说明战术界面，不直接展示本条规则。
observation.en: The aiming interface shows hit chance and expected damage; it provides tactical context rather than demonstrating this rule.

cases.rights: Firaxis Games, Feral Interactive (Mac), Feral Interactive (Linux)

implementation.zh: 火箭能破坏墙体并改变路线与视线，手榴弹的爆炸则不会像火箭一样拆墙。
implementation.en: Rockets can destroy walls and change routes and sightlines; grenade blasts do not destroy walls in the same way.

observation.zh: 俯视地图中可见绿色人物、白色规划路径与路径点；静态画面不能展示双方同时执行的全过程。
observation.en: Green units, white planned paths and waypoints are visible; the still cannot show the full simultaneous resolution.

contrast.zh: 《幽浮2》常用破坏掩体为后续射击创造条件；《冰封触点》拆墙还直接改变之后同时执行指令的可走路线。
contrast.en: XCOM 2 uses cover removal to prepare follow-up shots; Frozen Synapse wall destruction also changes routes for planned simultaneous orders.

setup.zh: 敌人躲在一段矮墙后，你有一枚炸弹和一名还没行动的射手。
setup.en: An enemy hides behind a low wall; you have one bomb and a shooter who has not acted.

action.zh: 先炸掉矮墙，再让射手对暴露的敌人开火。
action.en: Destroy the wall, then fire at the exposed enemy.

result.zh: 射击条件改善，但这片区域之后也不能保护你的队员。
result.en: The shot improves, but the area can no longer protect your own units.

next.zh: 你重新挑选下一回合的落脚点，避免站在刚炸开的空地。
next.en: Choose the next turn’s position away from the newly exposed ground.

firstStep.zh: 用格子地图中可切换“完整／摧毁”的矮墙，重算通路和视线；不做真实碎裂模拟。
firstStep.en: Use tiled walls that switch between intact and destroyed, updating paths and sightlines without debris simulation.

pitfall.zh: 画面已经炸开但寻路仍然绕墙，或看似完整却不再挡枪，会破坏理解。
pitfall.en: Destroyed visuals with old pathing, or intact-looking walls that no longer block fire, undermine clarity.

test.zh: 破坏同一堵墙前后，让试玩者指出新增路线、暴露目标和自己失去的保护。
test.en: Before and after breaking a wall, ask testers to identify new routes, exposed targets and lost protection.

combination.zh: 把战前建造接到可破坏掩体：玩家自己布置的防线，也可能在战斗中被打开缺口。
combination.en: Connect pre-battle construction to destructible cover so player-built defenses can develop breaches during combat.
